scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('./dist',{recursive:true})" && frida-compile index.js -o dist/index.js && node pack.js
scripts.dev: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('./dist',{recursive:true})" && frida-compile index.js -o dist/index.js && python run.py -t D:\program\Steam\steamapps\common\DeathRoadToCanada\prog.exe -s ./dist/index.js
scripts.install: pip install frida && pip install frida-tools
scripts.which: which frida-compile && frida-compile --version && which frida && frida --version
